name: Mount Taishan
description: Mount Taishan rises to 1,545 metres at Jade Emperor Peak, the highest point in China's Shandong province, just north of the city of Tai'an. Revered as the eastern one of China's five sacred mountains and linked with sunrise and renewal, it has drawn worshippers for at least 3,000 years, and emperors held rituals here for nearly 2,000. Temples and carved inscriptions blend into its dramatic slopes.
